reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here shows reviews, Trustpilot or a track record, so I'd be googling 'is Nora Furnish legit' before I put a card in. And that paper cloud pendant looks like something I could find cheaper on Amazon or AliExpress.
objection: No reviews or track record that I can see, and a 10 to 12 day wait (6 weeks if made to order) on a store I don't know, with return shipping on me if it looks different in person.
would_change_my_mind: A solid pile of independent reviews (Trustpilot or similar) from real buyers with photos, plus a trade or designer discount and free returns on unopened items.
